preset.header: Welcome to Rat in the Kitchen!

params.name: format
params.value: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!

params.name: format
params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.header: (1/4) A group of chefs are serving entrees...
preset.text:
... but they are keeping a secret from their customers - there is a rat in their kitchen!

Among the chefs are some rebellious health inspectors who believe the restaurant should be shut down. They are covertly trying to find the rat and report the restaurant for a health violation.

Players are secretly assigned to one of 2 teams: the Chefs and the Inspectors. In either case, you do NOT know who your teammates are.

params.name: format
params.value: (2/4) There is a deck of ($1) cards...

params.name: format
params.value:
In this deck there are:
... 1 Rat card
... ($1) Entree cards
... and ($2) Dirty Dish cards.

The Chefs are trying to flip over all the Entree cards. If they can serve all the entrees before the rat gets discovered, they save their restaurant!

The Inspectors are trying to flip over the 1 Rat card, OR prevent the Chefs from finding all the Entree cards in time. If they do this, the restaurant is forced to close down.

preset.header: (3/4) There are 4 rounds in the game

params.name: format
params.value:
At the start of every round, the unflipped cards get shuffled and dealt evenly to all the players. You will see your cards in your hand, and they will be placed in a random order in the center for other players to flip over.

On your turn, you choose to flip another player's card. Once you flip over a player's card, THAT player takes the next turn. The round ends after ($1) new cards have been flipped over.

preset.header: (4/4) What do you have in your hand?
preset.text:
The strategy of the game lies in sharing what cards you have in your hand, which will influence whether other players try to flip over one of your cards.

Should you be honest about your cards?If you're an Inspector and you believe someone has the Rat card, should you try to flip over one of their cards and give yourself away?

Let's get ready to play Rat in the Kitchen!

params.value: ($1), choose a card to flip over!
